content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - us-west1 primary GPU pool queue growth detected. avg queue length > 6000, head latency spiking. Autoscaler failing to provision: 'quota_exhausted'. Error sample: `Request to GCE quota API returned 403`. Affects generation routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.

sophie (oncall): on it. grabbing logs and runbook. paging infra and sres.

jordan: seeing repeated 'scaleup: max_nodes_reached' in autoscaler logs too. looks like we've hit per-project GPU count (regional).

akshay: confirmed - quota cap at 48 GPUs for region us-west1, pool wants 72. opened cloud quota request but not instantaneous.

maria-sre: what customer impact are we seeing? any 5xx or reroutes?

ops-bot: Telemetry snapshot: 5xx rate for us-west1 from 00:12 UTC -> 7.1%. p95 latency for /v1/generate = 3.8s (baseline 0.7s). Queue depth growth rate +1200/min. Active requests stalled ~2.8k.

sophie (oncall): flagged AcmeCorp and three other enterprise tenants with heavy routing to us-west1. CS looped in. @cs-rep can you confirm?

cs-rep: AcmeCorp reported elevated latency and some failed requests. They're seeing timeouts on 10% of their calls. They've switched to a low-priority batch but want ETA.

jordan: starting manual spillover to us-east1 for non-pin customers. will exclude any tenant pinned to us-west1. runbook step: `routing-service set-policy --region-fallback us-east1 --threshold 70`

sophie (oncall): execute and monitor. also reduce default batching to avoid ramping queue: `runtime-config update --max-batch-size 8`

leo-sre: applied routing change, starting gradual 20% shift from us-west1 -> us-east1 now. pushing to 100% in 5m if healthy.

maria-sre: after 2m: us-east1 acceptance OK, latency stable. us-west1 5xx rate dropping from 7.1% -> 4.2% but queue still large.

akshay: still can't scale up in us-west1 until quota increase or we free capacity. suggest eviction of low-priority reserved tasks and tenancy shedding.

jordan: triggering eviction for ephemeral batch jobs: `orchestrator evict --pool us-west1 --label batch-ephemeral --grace 30s`

sophie (oncall): evictions started. also enabling manual warm nodes from regional spare pool (us-central spare) as temporary: `allocator attach --from us-central --to us-west1 --count 8` (this will be slower but gives headroom).

ops-bot: attach job accepted, provisioning delayed ~90s.

maria-sre: customer impact update: AcmeCorp timeouts dropped to 3% after 35% spillover. mean latency normalized to ~1.4s. documenting for postmortem.

jordan: autoscaler error trace: intermittent `rate limit` on provisioning API, combined with quota_exhausted -> causes backoff loop. Need retry logic + alerting to quota nearing thresholds.

sophie (oncall): handoff plan: I'm keeping watch for 30m then handing to leo-sre for mitigation and post-incident cleanup. @jordan continue with infra actions, @akshay follow up with cloud quota support, @maria-sre compile customer impact notes.

akshay: opened high-priority ticket with cloud support (case 2438921). ETA TBD but noted emergency escalation.

leo-sre: taking the 30m watch. next steps: create temporary route caps so we don't saturate secondary region if this recurs, and add a short-circuit fallback to degrade non-critical routes to cached responses.

maria-sre: adding initial impact summary to incident doc: "Affected region: us-west1. Root cause: regional GPU quota exhaustion + autoscaler inability to retry/provision under rate limits. Customer visible: elevated latency and 5xx for ~12% of requests at peak. Mitigations: routing spillover to us-east1, evict ephemeral batch jobs, attach spare nodes from us-central."

sophie (oncall): thumbs. action items for postmortem: (1) autoscaler retry/backoff fixes, (2) quota monitoring alert thresholds, (3) routing policy to prefer cross-region spillover earlier, (4) runbook step to pre-warm spare nodes when queue growth > X.

jordan: will add immediate tactical change: reduce default max-concurrent-requests per model in us-west1 to 60% of pool capacity to prevent head-of-queue starvation.

akshay: cloud case updated: support acknowledged emergency, possible quota bump in 2-6h. will update.

cs-rep: told AcmeCorp we diverted some traffic to us-east1 and are monitoring. asked if they want a dedicated fallback for future planned maintenance. they said yes, want a guaranteed cross-region failover window.

leo-sre: scheduled follow-up: apply a temporary traffic cap policy and draft runbook edits. will create a post-incident ticket with owners: autoscaler (jordan), quota/infra (akshay), routing (leo), CS coordination (maria).

sophie (oncall): closing immediate paging state. if queue growth resumes or 5xx >5% re-open pager. great work team :thumbsup: :rocket:

incident-bot: Incident state: MONITORED -> degraded -> mitigated (partial). Incident ID IID-2026-0456. Log snippets and actions attached to incident doc.

maria-sre: last note - include customer list and timestamps in the postmortem. I'll draft and share with CS for outreach.

leo-sre: taking it from here for the next watch. will coordinate cleanup: revert routing once us-west1 healthy and ensure evicted jobs are retried gracefully.

jordan: left a small diagnostic command to capture autoscaler backoff patterns:```bash
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler --since=20m | grep -E "quota|rate limit|max_nodes"
```

sophie (oncall): thanks all. handing to @leo-sre at 1768010780.

leo-sre: ack. monitoring window started.
